metadata.description: Abracadabrax media plugins for Claude: images, videos and songs rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-image-video
plugins.description: AI image generator and AI video generator: turn a text prompt into an image or a video, pick model, format and length with Claude, and render it with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-song-maker
plugins.description: AI song and music maker: write lyrics with Claude and have Abracadabrax sing and produce the track, or create an instrumental, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-ai-video-generator
plugins.description: AI video generator: describe a scene and Claude prepares a short clip for YouTube, TikTok, Reels or Shorts, with style, format, length and video model (Kling, Seedance, Sora, Veo), rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-background-music-generator
plugins.description: AI background music generator: describe the mood and what it is for, and Claude prepares an instrumental track for a video, podcast, ad, game, stream or study session, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-birthday-song-maker
plugins.description: Birthday song maker: tell Claude who the song is for and a few memories, write the lyrics together, and Abracadabrax sings and produces a personalized birthday song, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-poster-flyer-maker
plugins.description: Poster and flyer maker: give Claude the headline and the details of your event, sale or announcement, and Abracadabrax designs a print-ready poster or flyer with the text on it, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-product-photo-generator
plugins.description: AI product photo generator: describe your product and Claude prepares a white-background packshot, a lifestyle scene, a flat lay, a hero banner or a close-up for your store or ads, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-social-media-image
plugins.description: Social media image maker: describe your post and Claude prepares an image sized for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest or a vertical story, with optional text and brand colors, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-youtube-thumbnail-maker
plugins.description: YouTube thumbnail maker: tell Claude what the video is about and the headline you want, and Abracadabrax designs a bold 16:9 thumbnail with readable text, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.
